testcase.name: Scenario: Stage and remove repeated separators: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:601:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Stage and remove repeated separators ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows an empty Part Tools custom panel ✔ And the source category is All Commands ✔ When the user double-clicks "<Separator>" in the available commands list ✔ Then the custom panel list contains one separator ✔ And "<Separator>" remains in the available commands list ✔ When the user double-clicks "<Separator>" in the available commands list again ✔ Then the custom panel list contains two separator rows ✔ And "<Separator>" remains in the available commands list ✔ When the user double-clicks the first separator row in the custom panel list ✔ Then one separator row remains in the custom panel list ✔ And the target indicates a pending change ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no User Commands panel appears on the Tools ribbon
